name: greeter
description: Single-endpoint Go HTTP service: GET /hello?name=X returns a JSON greeting ("Hello, X"), defaulting to "Hello, World!" when name is omitted and rejecting a name over 40 characters with a 400. Follows the layout and JSON error-shape conventions in app-factory-kaj/e2e-reference (cmd/<service>/main.go entrypoint, net/http, {"error": "message"} error bodies, PORT env var). Holds no persisted state, no authentication, and no other endpoints beyond a health check.
